title: Three amended blueprints apply cleanly in every ordering with one-owner-per-topic in the manifest
purpose: Cover the two ACs on US-1201: no globalAdrTopic conflict on healthProbes/readinessSemantics during apply in any of the six permutations, and one-and-only-one probe-endpoints scope:global claimant per topic in the resulting manifest.

testCases.description: The first of six orderings (essentials -> probe-endpoints -> api-rest) is exercised here as the resolved test-point representative of the parameterised assertion; the other five permutations run in the same suite file (assertion 1 (apply cleanly in every ordering): ...) and share this AC.
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/probe-path-alignment.test.js::assertion 1 (apply cleanly in every ordering): observability-essentials -> observability-probe-endpoints -> application-api-rest

testCases.description: After applying all three blueprints into a fresh project tree, exactly one scope:global ADR on healthProbes and one on readinessSemantics are present in the manifest, both owned by observability-probe-endpoints
testCases.testPointer: test/blueprint/probe-path-alignment.test.js::assertion 2: one owner per topic across the applied manifest
